title: Türkiye Sürdürülebilirlik Raporlama Standartları (TSRS 1 and TSRS 2), Kamu Gözetimi, Muhasebe ve Denetim Standartları Kurulu decision published in the Resmî Gazete of 2023-12-29
citation: KGK Board decisions of 27/12/2023 published in Resmî Gazete 32414 (mükerrer), 29 December 2023; standards at https://www.kgk.gov.tr/SustainabilityDetailForm/11455/Raporlama%20Standartlar%C4%B1
evidence: KGK FAQ (https://kgk.gov.tr/surdurulebilirlik-sss, opened 2026-11-02): "Zorunlu sürdürülebilirlik raporlaması yapmak durumunda olan şirketlerin, 1/1/2024 tarihinde başlayan hesap dönemi için sürdürülebilirlik raporlaması yapması zorunludur." This is the date the duty first applies; the decisions' own commencement clause is in the gazette PDFs, which have no text layer.
notes: Link only. TR-KGK-ADOPTED is permission requested (kgk.gov.tr carries only a copyright footer). The Resmî Gazete copy (https://www.resmigazete.gov.tr/eskiler/2023/12/20231229M1.htm, items 20231229M1-6.pdf to -10.pdf, each HTTP 200 application/pdf) is not stored because Turkish Law 5846 art. 31 names kanun, Cumhurbaşkanlığı kararnamesi, yönetmelik, tebliğ, genelge and kazai karar but not a board decision, and because the gazette PDFs are page images with no text layer. The index lists KGK decisions numbered 21460, 21462, 21464, 21465, 21463, 21621, 21632 and 21634 of 22 to 27 December 2023; which of them carry TSRS 1 and TSRS 2 and the entity scope was not read from an official text (secondary sources name 21632 for the standards and 21634 for the scope). TSRS 1 and TSRS 2 are Türkiye's versions of IFRS S1 and S2. Later KGK decisions (transitional relief, assurance) were not opened. For Varun: reading art. 31 to cover a KGK decision would make the gazette copy storable, but the images would need OCR. English: none found; the KGK publishes TSRS in Turkish only.

title: Kurumsal Yönetim Tebliği (II-17.1), Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu, with Ek-1 Kurumsal Yönetim İlkeleri and the sustainability principles provision

notes: Records: adopted 2014-01-03 (Resmî Gazete) and consolidated 2020-10-02 (Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi), the date of the only amendment, Tebliğ (II-17.1.a), whose madde 3 says it takes effect on publication; it adds the sustainability principles provisions (madde 1 fifth paragraph, madde 8 as amended). title: İklim Kanunu (Climate Law), Law No. 7552
citation: Law No. 7552, accepted 2/7/2025, Resmî Gazete 9/7/2025, No. 32951
evidence: Madde 19: "Bu Kanun yayımı tarihinde yürürlüğe girer." Published in Resmî Gazete 9 Temmuz 2025, Sayı 32951 (https://www.resmigazete.gov.tr/eskiler/2025/07/20250709-1.htm), opened 2026-11-02.
notes: Framework climate act; it also creates the Emisyon Ticaret Sistemi (family F3 is covered by the two ETS regulations, which cite this Law). Two records for 2025-07-09: the gazette item (which includes the amendments the Law makes to other laws) and the Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi consolidated text (the Law's own articles with footnotes; the only footnote points to the 2026 penalty communiqué). The text was not changed by any amendment found in the consolidation. Administrative fines are fixed each year by tr-iklim-idari-para-cezasi-teblig. English: no government translation found. Looked at mevzuat.gov.tr (Turkish only), resmigazete.gov.tr (Turkish only) and the ministry English news pages on iklim.gov.tr/en (news summaries, not translations of the text); a translation by a law firm or news site is never stored.
